display.purpose: Manrope hero heading; responsive overrides are documented in DESIGN.md.

title.purpose: Service headings; proof rows have smaller local sizes.

body.purpose: Global base; local copy uses denser sizes and generous leading.

emphasis.purpose: Expressive inline emphasis, signatures, outcomes and quotes; font-style italic is required.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: 26px rise, 5px blur; essential content visible without scripts.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disable smooth scrolling, reveal transforms, parallax and previews; reduce animation/transition duration to .01ms, show content immediately, begin footer video paused.

motion.name: concept-words
motion.purpose: Sequential darkening tied to viewport passage, reversible on upward scroll.

motion.name: concept-tags
motion.purpose: Independent ±6px x, ±11px y and ±3deg rotation plus restrained scroll offset. Static under reduced motion.

components.name: Rolling Primary Button
components.description: Pill action with duplicate rolling label and circular arrow.

components.name: Book Tab
components.description: Outlined book selector with wine selected treatment; runtime adds roving focus and arrow-key selection.

components.name: Floating Navigation
components.description: Three section links and one contact action, without a brand block. Mobile preserves contact plus menu toggle.
components.html: ServiçosProjetosSobreVamos conversar
components.css: .ds-nav{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:6px 7px 6px 16px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(250,248,244,.78);backdrop-filter:blur(22px) saturate(1.2);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.55),0 12px 30px -23px rgba(10,15,21,.4);font:400 13px/1.6 Manrope,Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#0a0f15)}.ds-nav a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;padding:12px 17px}.ds-nav .ds-brand{font:italic 37px/1 'Instrument Serif',Georgia,serif;color:var(--wine,#721919);padding:0 18px 5px 0}.ds-nav a:hover{color:var(--wine,#721919)}.ds-nav .ds-contact{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:15px;background:var(--wine,#721919);color:#fff;padding:12px 20px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:500;transition:background .3s}.ds-nav .ds-contact:hover{background:var(--red,#c1121f);color:#fff}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--red,#c1121f);outline-offset:6px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-contact{transition-duration:.01ms!important}}

narrative.overview: The implemented world follows the user-selected Leticia Bassan grammar: Manrope structure, Instrument Serif Italic expression, warm paper, editorial photography and compact rounded controls. Julia's wine and red accents make that grammar her own. Spacious reading regions alternate with compact evidence rows; portraits and actual artifacts carry the visual weight. Motion adds pacing while essential content remains accessible without it.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper with wine anchors and active red details
Manrope structure and Instrument Serif Italic expression
Floating pill navigation and rolling-label circular-arrow controls
Rounded photography with flat text and ruled evidence

rules.name: The Accent Continuity Rule
rules.body: Carry wine and red through typography and controls rather than assigning a new accent to every section.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Keep Manrope for structure and Instrument Serif Italic for emphasis; preserve the selected pairing.

dos: Do preserve the selected type pair and wine/red hierarchy.
Do use actual artifacts and editorial portraits.
Do preserve touch, keyboard and reduced-motion access.
donts: Don't replace the selected visual identity.
Don't turn every grouping into an elevated card.
Don't hide essential outcomes behind hover.
Don't bake headings or controls into photographs.
Don't impose the current hero composition on every future page.
